content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Deviation — § 14.2 (critical, ip-data).** Vendor took exclusive ownership of every Deliverable created for Customer, leaving us only a revocable, non-transferable licence limited to the Order Form term. That is contrary to our "we own what we pay for" position and is internally inconsistent with the perpetual paid-up licence in § 13.2 and the Deliverable definition in § 1.4 (which already carves out Vendor Technology and unaided know-how).

Redline (validated, preferred level): Customer owns each Deliverable with an express Vendor assignment, while Vendor Technology stays with Vendor under § 14.3 and is licensed to us under § 13.2. Fallback flagged in the comment: Vendor retains generic tools but we get the perpetual, irrevocable § 13.2 licence.

No changes needed to § 14.1 (Customer Data and pre-existing IP correctly stay with us), § 14.3, § 14.4 (no joint ownership; feedback rights preserved) or § 15.1.
